items.raw_excerpt: If you hear this phrase, brace yourself for drama and possible disruption.
items.summary_en: This phrase means the joining of different protest movements into one. You may hear it when strikes and marches come together. It often signals drama and possible disruption ahead.
items.summary_ko: 이 표현은 서로 다른 시위 움직임이 하나로 모이는 것을 뜻한다. 파업과 행진이 함께 일어날 때 자주 들을 수 있다. 종종 큰 소동과 혼잡이 이어질 수 있다는 신호이기도 하다.

items.raw_excerpt: This Italian phrase is nothing to lose your cool over.
items.summary_en: This article explains an Italian phrase. 'Perdere le staffe' means to lose your temper. It is a fun, everyday saying.

items.raw_excerpt: A new EU rule placing a tariff of at least three euros on any parcel worth 150 euros or less came into force on July 1st this year. Since then, the number of small parcels entering Denmark from outside the EU has fallen sharply.
items.summary_en: A new EU rule now adds a fee of at least three euros to parcels worth 150 euros or less. The rule started on July 1st. Since then, far fewer small parcels arrive in Denmark from outside the EU.
items.summary_ko: 새 유럽연합 규칙은 150유로 이하 소포에 최소 3유로의 요금을 붙인다. 이 규칙은 올해 7월 1일부터 시행됐다. 그 뒤로 유럽연합 밖에서 덴마크로 들어오는 소형 소포가 크게 줄었다.
items.title_en: Fewer small parcels reach Denmark after new EU customs rule
items.title_ko: 새 유럽연합 규칙 뒤 덴마크로 오는 소형 소포 급감
items.title_original: Number of small parcels at Danish customs plummets after new EU rule

items.raw_excerpt: Kerala HC upholds a headmistress’s right to wear a churidar, ruling attire choices are personal and not legally restricted.
items.summary_en: The Kerala High Court ruled that a school headmistress can wear a churidar. The court said clothing is a personal choice and is not limited by law. The case began from a dispute over her dress.
items.summary_ko: 케랄라 고등법원이 한 학교 교장이 추리다르를 입을 수 있다고 판결했다. 법원은 옷차림은 개인의 선택이며 법으로 제한할 수 없다고 밝혔다. 이 사건은 교장의 복장을 둘러싼 다툼에서 시작됐다.
items.title_en: Court says a school headmistress may wear a churidar
items.title_ko: 케랄라 고등법원, 교장의 추리다르 착용 인정
items.title_original: ‘Attire is a citizen’s choice’: Kerala HC backs school headmistress over churidar row

items.raw_excerpt: The cabinet is set to announce a €50 million investment in the Port of Rotterdam for nature conservation measures, including releasing rabbits into the dunes, which would allow for harbour growth. Permits for new businesses and expansion of existing enterprises have been at a virtual standstill for years over concerns about nitrogen pollution in protected areas surrounding the port. Industry at the port has been shrinking in recent years, hamstrung by a lack of expansion and renovation options a
items.summary_en: The Dutch cabinet will invest 50 million euros in nature work at the Port of Rotterdam. The plan includes releasing rabbits into the dunes to help nature. This may let the harbour grow again after years of limits.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 정부가 로테르담 항구의 자연 보전에 5천만 유로를 투자한다. 계획에는 토끼를 모래언덕에 풀어 자연을 돕는 내용이 담겼다. 이 덕분에 수년간 막혔던 항구 확장이 다시 가능해질 전망이다.
items.title_en: Rotterdam harbour looks to rabbits to help with expansion

items.raw_excerpt: The government-funded Taiwan Panorama magazine is celebrating its 50th anniversary with an exhibition of some of its best photographs of Taiwan's social, economic and political development over the past half-century.
items.summary_en: Taiwan Panorama magazine is 50 years old. It is holding an exhibition of its best photos of Taiwan. The pictures show the island's social, economic and political changes.

items.raw_excerpt: Visitors to the chateau in the tiny village of Liettres in northern France heard some unfamiliar terminology this weekend, at an international cricket tournament.
items.summary_en: A small village in northern France held an international cricket tournament. Visitors to the local chateau heard new words from the sport. The event was called historic for the area.

items.summary_en: A Northern Territory regulator says it has low confidence in the current plan for a data centre in the outback. The agency wants more details before it can approve the project.

items.raw_excerpt: Workers at AGC Display Glass Taiwan Inc. in Yunlin County will end their four-day strike Thursday evening after reaching an agreement with management on wage increases for 2027 and 2028, the company's union said.
items.summary_en: Workers at AGC Display Glass Taiwan in Yunlin County went on strike for four days. The union said they reached a deal with management on wage increases for 2027 and 2028. The workers will return to work on Thursday evening.

items.raw_excerpt: A total of 265 foreign motorists were stopped at Singapore’s land checkpoints as part of a multi-agency operation in late September over outstanding fines.
items.summary_en: Officers stopped 265 foreign motorists at Singapore's land checkpoints in late September. The drivers had unpaid traffic fines, and more than S$639,000 was collected. Several agencies took part in the joint operation.
items.summary_ko: 9월 말 싱가포르 육상 검문소에서 외국인 운전자 265명이 단속됐다. 이들은 내지 않은 교통 범칙금이 있었고, 63만9000싱가포르달러가 넘는 금액이 징수됐다. 여러 기관이 함께한 합동 단속이었다.
items.title_en: Foreign drivers pay S$639,000 in unpaid fines at Singapore checkpoints

items.title_original: More than S$639,000 in outstanding fines recovered from foreign motorists at Singapore's land checkpoints

items.raw_excerpt: Reportedly worth Rs 50-80 crore, the veteran actor kept a 1BHK flat, a Goa home and a farm near Pune. Here is where he lived, and what he said about choosing village life.
items.summary_en: Indian actor Nana Patekar is said to own property worth Rs 50-80 crore. He still keeps a small 1BHK flat, a home in Goa, and a farm near Pune. He has spoken about why he chose a simple, village-like life.
items.summary_ko: 인도 배우 나나 파테카르는 약 50~80크로르 루피의 재산을 가진 것으로 알려졌다. 그는 작은 1BHK 아파트와 고아의 집, 푸네 근처 농장을 두고 지낸다. 그는 소박한 마을 같은 삶을 택한 이유를 직접 이야기했다.

items.raw_excerpt: The Local's readers come from around the world, but what they missed from their homelands now that they've built a life in Sweden was remarkably similar – which probably says more about Sweden than it does about other countries.
items.summary_en: Many foreigners living in Sweden say they miss flavorful food and friendliness from home. Their shared answers say more about Sweden than about other countries.

items.raw_excerpt: You may be familiar with the basic way Spaniards say ‘cheers’, but there are other Spanish expressions and habits associated with clinking glasses and making a toast that you’ll be happy to learn.
items.summary_en: You may already know the basic way Spaniards say cheers. There are other Spanish words and habits used when clinking glasses. These local toasts are fun and easy to learn.

items.raw_excerpt: The city council voted against an outright ban on face coverings at a meeting on Wednesday, but a new safety guideline for schools will be issued.
items.summary_en: Helsinki city council voted against a full ban on face coverings in schools. Instead, the city will issue a new safety guideline for schools.

items.raw_excerpt: A review has found no evidence of fraud or misappropriation by an RSA that used poppy trust funds to prop up its club.
items.summary_en: An audit looked at an RSA that used poppy trust funds to support its club. It found serious governance mistakes and failures. But it found no evidence of fraud or misuse of money.
items.summary_ko: 양귀비 신탁 기금을 클럽 운영에 사용한 RSA가 감사를 받았다. 감사 결과 심각한 운영 실수와 실패가 드러났다. 하지만 사기나 자금 유용의 증거는 발견되지 않았다.
items.title_en: Audit finds mistakes but no fraud at RSA club
items.title_ko: RSA 감사, 운영 실수는 있었지만 사기 증거는 없어

items.raw_excerpt: The 2026 Taiwan Writers Festival will bring together authors and translators from the United States, Australia, South Korea, Japan, Singapore, Finland and Poland to meet and hold discussions with their Taiwanese counterparts next month, organizers said Thursday.
items.summary_en: A writers festival will take place in Taiwan next month. Authors and translators from eight countries will meet local Taiwanese writers. The event aims to share ideas and stories across cultures.
items.summary_ko: 다음 달 대만에서 문학 축제가 열린다. 미국, 호주, 한국, 일본 등 여덟 나라의 작가와 번역가들이 참여한다. 이들은 대만 작가들과 만나 이야기와 생각을 나눌 예정이다.
items.title_en: Taiwan to host foreign writers at November festival
items.title_ko: 대만, 11월 문학 축제서 해외 작가들과 만남

items.summary_en: The Queen of Thailand flew a Gripen fighter jet by herself for the first time. The solo flight took place in Surat Thani on Thursday. She is known for her interest in aviation.
